mapper.select: SELECT id FROM nw_channels WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{channelId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_channels SET api_key_hash=#{apiKeyHash}, api_secret_encrypted=#{apiSecretEncrypted}, updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{channelId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.channel_id, b.agent_id, COALESCE(a.name,'') AS name, b.priority, b.traffic_percentage, b.is_default FROM nw_channel_agent_bindings b LEFT JOIN nw_agents a ON a.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND a.id=b.agent_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.channel_id IN #{id} ORDER BY b.id

SELECT id, tenant_id, channel_type, name, config, ui_config, status, created_at, updated_at, channel_token_hash, channel_token_prefix, api_key_hash, api_secret_encrypted FROM public.resolve_channel_by_token_hash(#{tokenHash})
